newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seesaw to end down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seesaw to end down.

text.p: Pakistani stocks moved both ways before finishing down on Tuesday amid speculative trade on the settlement day, dealers said.
"The market sentiment is weak as major investors are still waiting for a strong positive news before moving in," dealer Ali Raza Mooney said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 3.02 points, or 0.19 percent, to end at 1,565.81 after rising to 1,572.08 in early trade. Losers led gainers 223 to 56. Turnover fell to 41 million shares from 45 million on Monday.
Bank of Punjab fell 2.70 rupees to 25.35, D.G. Khan Cement 0.45 to 15.25 and FFC Jordan Fertilizer 0.20 to 17.20. PTCL rose 0.15 to 29.45 and ICI Pakistan 0.20 to 24.40.
